subject: physics
question_text: What is relative velocity? Obtain an expression for the velocity of one body relative to another when both are moving in a plane.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The definition
lines: The relative velocity of a body A with
respect to a body B is the velocity of A
as measured by an observer moving along
steps.why: Every velocity is measured against something; naming the observer is what makes the number mean anything at all.
common_mistakes: Treating relative velocity as a difference of speeds — it is a difference of vectors.

recall.must_convey: That relative velocity of A with respect to B is the velocity of A as seen by an observer moving with B.
accept: velocity of A as seen from B

steps.label: The expression
lines: Let v_A and v_B be the velocities measured
from the ground. In one second A moves v_A
and B moves v_B, so the shift of A as seen
steps.why: Subtracting v_B is the same as riding on B: it cancels B’s own motion out of every measurement.
common_mistakes: Adding the two velocities instead of subtracting them.

recall.must_convey: That v of A with respect to B is v A minus v B, and the reverse is its negative.
